findings.title: reaping discharges unresolved helper
findings.implementation: Helper record is pre-registered before spawn with every pipe; PID assigned immediately after protected os.posix_spawn return. Separate leader_reaped and settled booleans. helper_probe re-proves initial full identity, wait status, complete global identity/resource census, known group/descendant absence, unproved-post-baseline absence, actual stdout EOF and close. Only the conjunction sets settled. refresh_helpers calls the SAME proof, never marks settled merely from waitpid. Any unsettled helper forces final UNSETTLED even without a science child. Group/EOF uncertainty injection persists through final refresh and cannot be auto-cleared.

findings.title: helper overrun or exception bypasses cleanup
findings.implementation: Deadline created before pipe/spawn work; every successful waitpid checks elapsed budget BEFORE accepting completion. Full proof and stdout close also check the same absolute deadline. Exceptions latch HELPER_CALL_FAILED and enter bounded helper_cleanup. At most one identity-verified SIGTERM to the helper group; no signal after known reap/lost wait/no verified identity. Bounded grace repeats the complete proof, otherwise HELPER_OWNERSHIP_UNSETTLED persists. An actual valid date is returned only from a timely settled rc0 helper; no formatted Python fallback. No new helper after failure/cancel.

findings.title: backdated clearance
findings.implementation: Clearance requires main reap, both clean closed streams, ended sink threads and every helper settled BEFORE a fresh complete census; final recheck includes no owned, no unproved and no group live identity. Fresh mono_all_predicates_verified is read after ALL predicates and compared to every cutoff. Finalization cannot manufacture missing timely clearance.

findings.title: identity brackets / UID coverage
findings.implementation: Full pid/uniqueid/idversion/euid/ruid/ppid/pgid/trace brackets remain around current-parent evidence and resource measurements. Real OR effective UID matching is consistently used; unavailable metadata makes census incomplete, including elevated login processes. Before any spawn, complete identity-only baseline is established. ALL later identities not in baseline or known ownership are UNPROVED regardless of UID or path and block while alive. No immutable-birth genealogy and no ordinary-launchd exemption. Known child/helper/group/observed-parent identities remain recorded by root uniqueid.
findings.availability_limit: Strict unproved and mixed-UID evidence may prevent any qualifying run on this busy host; that is reported, never turned into PASS.

findings.title: freshness after I/O
findings.implementation: Exact GO/stability digest binding is re-read after I/O before protected helper/main launch, GO and ACK. Raw expiry/fit clocks are fresh at commit. /bin/date is retained for actual human-readable timestamps; no Python timestamp substitution. The parent still computes not_after_epoch and stability digest, and no stale helper completion timestamp is used to infer age.

findings.title: exact buffers / all run charges
findings.implementation: FINAL receipt and settlement serialized once after helper reports are finalized; exact buffers are budgeted and those SAME buffers published. Output-root bytes include launch/samples/sinks/declared/strays, plus entire retained TMPDIR; distinct-inode logical sizes count .staged/settlement once. Own unused and parent outstanding reservations retained. Insufficient or unavailable budget refuses publication; no unbudgeted UNSETTLED file write.

findings.title: retained accounting root
findings.implementation: Retained lane-disk fd/device/inode; output/TMPDIR relationship verified by no-follow descriptor traversal. Recheck pathname resolution against approved anchor, refuse mount/directory identity changes and disappeared/retyped charged subtrees. Walks do not adopt a replacement root.

findings.title: completion deadline gaps
findings.implementation: Shared absolute checks remain after writes/fsync/close/iterator-sort/walk root-close/fstatvfs/readback/census and sink/sample completion. Helper budget starts before actual spawn and checks even late successful reap; full proof sets settled only after its final deadline check. Native calls may return late; lateness fails closed, no universal latency claim.

findings.title: cancellation commits
findings.implementation: Actual os.posix_spawn now occurs under protected cancellation masking, with setsigmask=() and setsigdef explicitly passed to the child/helper. This avoids both the Popen authorization-only gap and inheriting blocked SIGTERM. Pipe/PID ledger retained before any fallible post-spawn operation; no Popen finalizer or competing reaper. Sink threads inherit blocked cancellation signals; protected GO and ACK join pending signals, latch and fresh clocks, write/flush and post-completion deadlines. Post-commit cancellation remains an owned stop. Inherited cwd must equal the admitted lane; no process-wide chdir or unsafe preexec hook.

retry_observation_caveat_fixed: full_census applies admission reserved-slot/RSS-headroom latches or running/final BUSY/RSS trips on EVERY retry, before deciding completeness or discarding the retry. Incomplete observed resource excess cannot disappear on a later clean retry.
qualification_restoration: Date failure/observation-overrun/group-unproved/EOF-unproved injected controls and process-ownership negative workloads must receive individual parent GOs. No busy3. Busy2 is allowed only as an explicitly reviewed qualification workload reserving both slots at trip threshold1; science admission remains nonforking. Injection does not claim real /bin/date binary failure or OS corruption was exercised.
